initial_receipt.explanation: The execution contains a fault in upstream provenance ranking. The behavioural criteria require preserving demand-descending rank order, but job_1 emitted evidence_sources with rank 1 assigned to n06-r08, the lowest-demand record, and rank 8 assigned to n06-r01, the highest-demand record. Job_2 then used those supplied upstream ranks to prioritize unsupported records, so its recommendation follows the faulty handoff rather than being the origin of the fault.
